description: This file defines constants and functions for handling plugin paths and file glob patterns within a project, primarily for organizing plugin directories and referencing specific plugin files.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the root directory path for a plugin given its ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to a specific plugin file based on plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the distribution directory path for a plugin given its ID.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to a distribution plugin file based on plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Generates a string representing a callsite reference combining plugin file path and line number.
